citation: Sahinovic A, et al. Sports Med Open 2025;11:96
protocol: 60-min treadmill run at about 70% VO2max (RUN 1) then incremental run to exhaustion (RUN 2), 1.5 h after placebo (placebo arm of a CBD dose-ranging crossover); HR at 20, 40, 60 min, glucose and lactate
population: 25 trained runners (16 M, 9 F), 30 +/- 7 y, VO2max 53.1 +/- 7.5 mL/kg/min
note: Many rows are median [IQR] rather than mean +/- SD; read the placebo column; sexes pooled.
